title: Statement of Changes in Immigration Rules, HC 693 (16 October 2014)
covers: Raises the Tier 1 (Investor) minimum to GBP 2 million from 6 November 2014, requires the full sum to be invested, removes the loan option, adds refusal grounds on source of funds. Explanatory memorandum annexed (PDF p. 78 onwards).

title: Statement of Changes in Immigration Rules, HC 863 (16 March 2011)
covers: Introduces accelerated settlement for Tier 1 (Investor) migrants (GBP 5m after 3 years, GBP 10m after 2 years) from 6 April 2011; 180-day absence rule; explanatory memorandum annexed.
